summary: The knowledge-mode dossiers were mostly sound on long-established Milwaukee history and matched the verified 2026 facts on the Giannis trade, Jenkins, roster and Cup group. Fixed: the swapped and incomplete City Edition history (live-checked), the closed Ardent, the closed Mitchell Park Domes, the Panthers' arena, a Cleveland nickname, purple-teal versus purple-green, Lent timing and Cup home-game wording. Strategy needs fixes on Lent dates, Cup home Fridays, a duplicated cream hex, the 1971 vs script-era conflation and City Edition avoidance. Most remaining risk sits in small venues, shops, artists and store doors, queued as unverifiable.
